text: If Doug pay rent, Doug own nothing. If Larry get rent, Larry own igloo.
This is Doug. Doug need igloo.
Igloo cost thirty thousand fish. Doug have twelve fish.
Larry also no have thirty thousand fish.
But Larry go to bank. Bank give Larry fish.
Larry buy igloo. Now Larry owe bank. One hundred fifty fish. Every month.
Larry no want pay. Larry find Doug.
Doug pay Larry 180. Larry pay bank 150. Larry keep 30.
Doug pay rent. Larry pay mortgage. Same igloo.
But only one name on igloo.
In real life, half of American renters spend over thirty percent of their paycheck on rent.
Thirty years later. Bank happy. Larry own igloo.
Larry buy second igloo. Larry find new Doug.
Rent or buy? What would you do? Tell Doug in the comments.
